reply_text: I've replied to Marcus in his DM. On 14 October he told me his standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is now on Thursdays at 16:30. Our DM history shows he hasn't changed it since. I haven't put anything on his calendar, but I offered to set up the recurring event if he wants it.
